rationale.usefulness: The connected progression from generation and verification through sampling, RLVR and distillation is highly actionable for Python/PyTorch learners and educators. Repository exercises and hardware notes support implementation, while the report gives concrete experiment and interface projects without promising tutoring outcomes.
rationale.impact: This is an educational synthesis of existing methods with the potential to improve practitioner understanding. The supplied evidence establishes curriculum and materials, not a new AI method, measured learning improvement or field-wide development effect. Its educational usefulness can be high while impact on AI development remains four.
rationale.novelty: The newly announced video sequence packages known methods around a small pretrained model and existing book/code. Its coherent teaching progression is valuable, but no new reasoning algorithm or demonstrated technical differentiation is claimed, supporting a low novelty score.
rationale.maturity: Eight substantial videos, existing companion notebooks, exercises and setup/troubleshooting material form a concrete learning resource. No full lecture viewing or numerical reproduction was performed, and GPU/runtime demands vary, so the resource is well developed without being independently validated end to end.
rationale.openness: The public companion implementation is identified as Apache-2.0, with readable notebooks and exercises suitable for adaptation and reproducible experiments. Separate book, video, pretrained-model, dataset and teacher-data rights prevent treating the complete course stack as uniformly permissive.

concerns: Non-blocking: no course-completion study, full viewing or notebook reproduction establishes learning effectiveness or runtime reliability; the draft says so.
Non-blocking: small-model math verification does not establish general reasoning, software-engineering or tutoring gains.
Separate publication gate: this reviewer rates impact 4; if final mean impact is below 5, the contract requires the 1,000-word tier and fresh review after any substantive revision.
